messages:
sam: dropping PR #4201 with a condensed migration guide + quick snippets for Python/TS. planning to merge in today's docs window (15:50 PT). reviewers?
rachel: I can do a tone pass. remind me to check terminology (workspace vs. tenant) and avoid vague words like "simple".
tom: I'll check the code examples. please don't inline secrets; use `Client.from_env()` and add a link to credentials setup.
sam: updated snippets to `Client.from_env()` and added credentials link. also trimmed the long paragraph into a short checklist.
linter-bot: markdown-lint: MD034 heading no consecutive blank lines -> migration.md: line 78.
sam: fixing heading spacing now, pushing.
preview-bot: docs preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4201 — please eyeball code rendering and the migration table.
rachel: tone pass done: changed a couple imperatives to softer suggestions (e.g., "Run this script" -> "You can run this script"). replaced "simple" with "straightforward" in two places.
tom: code looks good. one API nit: streaming example should be generator style. change this:
```python
with client.stream_responses(prompt) as s:
    for part in s:
        print(part.text)
```
to:
```python
for part in client.stream_responses(prompt):
    print(part.text)
```
this avoids implying a context manager that controls network sockets.
sam: switched to generator style and added a short note about backpressure and how to buffer safely. also added a rollback snippet in the runbook.
rachel: small suggestion: use active voice in the appendix headers (e.g., "Verify routes" not "Verification of routes"). non-blocking.
preview-bot: updated preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4201 — table looks good, code formatted.
linter-bot: build passed: 0 warnings.
tom: approving; left a tiny suggestion on an example error message.
rachel: approving from the docs POV.
sam: thanks all — merging at 16:00 PT unless anyone objects.
tom: 👍
rachel: no objections, merge away.
sam: merged PR #4201 — thanks for the quick reviews and the tone cleanup.
